title: ToxCast target-family bioactivity atlas pipeline (invitrodb v4.3)
description: Analysis pipeline and aggregate outputs for a cytotoxicity-filtered atlas of ToxCast intended target families in invitrodb v4.3. Quantifies selective versus cytotoxicity-linked actives by family, chemical multi-family promiscuity before and after filtering, and sensitivity to potency margins, assay format, and severe mc6 flags. Requires the public EPA ToxCast invitrodb v4.3 extracts (not redistributed).
